meta.name: game-build
meta.description: Build a risk-matched whitebox or the approved production game for its target runtime. Turn GAME_DESIGN, and ART_DIRECTION when production begins, into a minimal BUILD_BRIEF and a runnable candidate that can be iterated with replayable evidence. Use for prototype the riskiest design question, implement the approved game design, or turn this design into a running game. 游戏构建执行。先按最大风险做白盒，或在正式生产时把批准后的 GAME_DESIGN 与 ART_DIRECTION 压缩成最小 BUILD_BRIEF，在目标运行环境中实现可运行候选并用可回放证据迭代。用于验证高风险设计问题、构建游戏原型或实现批准方案。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把游戏设计稿变成可运行的交互原型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有游戏设计想快速做出可玩的白盒。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your game design into a runnable playable build.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn a game design into a runnable prototype.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先按最大风险做白盒,或把已批准的设计与美术方向压缩成最小构建简报,再在目标运行环境实现可运行的游戏候选,并产出可回放证据用于迭代。
howto.when: 当用户给出已批准的游戏设计(白盒至少需 GAME_DESIGN.md;正式生产还需 ART_DIRECTION.md),要求原型化最大风险、实现已批准方案或把设计变成可运行游戏时触发。

say.text: 把这个设计做成白盒,先验证最大风险的动作手感。
say.note: 会输出一个最小可玩原型与观察结果。

say.text: 设计已批准,按生产路径压缩成 BUILD_BRIEF 并生成可运行候选。
say.note: 会进入生产构建循环,产出候选与权威验证命令。

say.text: 用这份游戏设计原型化最需要验证的问题。
say.note: 会先声明 whitebox 并实现最小核心循环。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude first builds a whitebox for the biggest risk, or compresses an approved design and art direction into a minimal build brief, then creates a runnable game candidate for the target runtime with replayable evidence for iteration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an approved game design (whitebox needs GAME_DESIGN.md; production also needs ART_DIRECTION.md) and ask to prototype the riskiest question, implement the approved design, or turn the design into a running game.

say_en.text: Turn this design into a whitebox and verify the riskiest gameplay feel first.
say_en.note: Outputs a minimal playable prototype with observations.

say_en.text: Use this game design to prototype the question that most needs validation.
say_en.note: Declares whitebox and implements the smallest core loop first.
